functional_rationale: The group noun tsum2 is independently lexicographic, not inferred only from a software verb. MediaWiki also applies it to grouping page results, so this is not confined to a human organization. Head group plus image modifier is an authored own-language compound, not an attested fixed software assembly term.

Group data and saved work refer to editable stored state, including image references, crops, placement and normalization. They are intentionally distinct from the separately nominated PNG-save output rows. The data is not asserted to consist only of pixels, and work is not restricted to unfinished or temporary art.

Saved work is an explicit an-headed relative with an overt passive marker and retained-state wai. It describes the stored object, not success of this opening attempt. The relative is authored from own an+predicate and actual positive passive software usage; no unmarked postverbal relative is assumed.

The one-item noun phrase copies the singular classifier-plus-one form from the own digital missing-revision source. The generic textbook noun+number+classifier order is not blindly imposed on the separately attested one-item form. Image is an inanimate referent under the general an classifier.

The absent image belongs to the group and is one required source. The actual guard also rejects a path outside the allowed directory, so this is absence from the required valid source set, not a claim that somebody deleted the file or that all state is gone.
